_comment: Bijou Coolify env-group TEMPLATE. Every value here is a placeholder. Copy this file, fill in real values (NEVER commit the filled-in version), and feed to migrate-secrets-to-coolify.ps1 via -EnvFilePath, OR import directly via the Coolify API: POST /api/v1/envs/<group-uuid> with { key, value, is_required, is_runtime } per row. The migrate script handles create-or-update for each key.
description: Production env for the Bijou Coolify stack. Mirrored to Infisical as project 'bijou-prod' environment 'production' (if INFISICAL_TOKEN is set).

vars.source: same as SUPABASE_URL — the `service_role` key (NOT the anon key)
Same dashboard, the `anon` public key — used in static/login.html for GoTrue OAuth
Canonical domain. Per CLAUDE.md, NEVER override with a stale Fly secret like LOGIN_URL/APP_URL/DASHBOARD_URI.
Stripe dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → your endpoint → Signing secret
Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. The bridge sends this on every webhook to the backend; backend verifies.
Used by /static/admin.html (X-Admin-Key header) and the admin MCP server. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32.
Already in bijoux-monorepo/settings.json (key prefix standard_). Verify it's still valid in the Appwrite console.

vars.note: Set to true ONLY after the bucket 'bijou-kb-files' is created in Appwrite Storage (one-time bootstrap). Default is false → local-fs storage in packages/backend/uploads/.

vars.source: https://app.nango.dev → Environment Settings. Leave blank to disable the Integrations tab.
https://portal.telnyx.com → Auth. The current key is still on disk in plaintext per STATUS_2026-08-23 §6 — owner action to rotate.
After langfuse-web is up at its Coolify hostname, sign up at /auth/sign-up, copy the pk-lf-… key
Same as LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, the sk-lf-… secret

vars.note: The docker-compose service name. If langfuse is on a different host, set to the full URL.

vars.source: Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Must be 32+ chars.

vars.note: Per CLAUDE.md 2026-08-23: Composio was replaced by Nango. Keep this false.

post_create_actions: Run packages/backend/scripts/apply_migrations.py against the Supabase project to apply the 10 SQL migrations (the script is idempotent).

Bootstrap the Appwrite storage bucket if ENABLE_APPWRITE_STORAGE=true: from the Appwrite console, create bucket 'bijou-kb-files' with the read-permission rule you want (default deny for non-tenant files).

Set the corresponding env vars in the bridge service (packages/bridge/) — BRIDGE_SHARED_SECRET, BIJOU_BACKEND_URL=https://app.mybijou.xyz, BIJOU_BACKEND_API_KEY (same as BRIDGE_SHARED_SECRET), DB_PATH, WHATSAPP_SESSION_PATH.
